execution_law.default: onboarding creates one immutable zero-match state only from a content-identified authority-receipted arena recipe
execution_law.successor: each period consumes the exact immediately preceding state and never receives defaults
execution_law.opponent: each event carries and validates the real opponent prior state in the same arena scope
execution_law.dependence: eligible evidence root identities are unique within the pure closed period and PostgreSQL rejects reuse across every published period for the participant coordinate
execution_law.admission: PostgreSQL calculation may consume only a recipe already deposited by the protected authority lifecycle into the durable admission set for the exact active authority fingerprint and evidence epoch; calculation cannot create its own admission
execution_law.outcome: confirm refute draw or uncertain may be mapped only by the exact mapping contained in the content-identified arena recipe; separate authority admission determines whether that recipe may enter a world; absent unknown denied exhausted and invalid execution are not rating results
execution_law.order: events are internally canonicalized by immutable event identity before floating-point accumulation
execution_law.publication: the pure calculation emits an immutable successor and receipt; PostgreSQL owns append-only publication and replay conflict rejection
